candidate: Shenandoah Computing LLC proposed data-processing facility (MoDNR air construction permit application 2025-08-034, installation 165-0050), south-west corner of State Hwy 92 and N Winan Avenue, Kansas City (Platte County), Missouri
selected_point_role: area centroid of the applicant's fenceline polygon drawn on Figure 3 (Site Map) of the public air construction permit application, computed from the vector fenceline and the georeference embedded in that GeoPDF page; it locates the fenced site, not a building, footprint or works extent

source.document: Shenandoah Computing LLC air construction permit application, public version (Olsson, April 2026), posted by MoDNR as the public application complete in September 2026; Appendix A, Figure 3 Site Map (PDF page 13), scale 1 in = 700 ft, basemap Google Earth imagery

georeference_read.affine_fit: least-squares affine from the four LPTS corners of the viewport BBox to the GPTS corners projected into the embedded CRS

source.fenceline_read: the only non-legend stroked path in pure yellow (RG 1 1 0, width 2), 24 vertices, closed; the legend swatch at x 301-319 pt is excluded. Building outlines are the orange (RG 1 0.667 0) stroked rectangles, legend swatch excluded.

building_outlines.note: the outlines are preliminary plan rectangles and are not used as the locator

plss_section.note: The application narrative gives Section 34, Township 53N, Range 33W. The georeferenced fence lies in Section 3, T52N, R34W; its north-east corner is the junction below, which is also the south-east corner of Section 34, T53N, R34W, so the narrative's range (33W, about 9 km east) is inconsistent with the application's own maps and road names and is treated as a clerical error.

road_junction.description: Census TIGER road segments (served by MSDIS): N Winan Ave ends at the start of a 92 Hwy segment; State Hwy 92 passes the same node

source.dataset_vintage: City of Kansas City Parcels (data.kcmo.org 6g4y-sh3m), rows updated 30 December 2023

parcels_intersecting_fence.owner_of_record_dec_2023: not copied (private individual or personal trust)
not copied (private individual or personal trust)

fence_vertex_to_parcel_line_distance_m.note: the largest value is an intermediate vertex on the straight west line, not a parcel corner

kcmo_parcels.jurisdiction: the parcels are City of Kansas City, Missouri KIVA parcels in Section 3, T52N, R34W (Platte County)

geometry_checks.verification: pypdf 5.1.0 content-stream parse; pyproj 3.7.1 Geod(GRS80) and Transformer; shapely 2.1.1; numpy least squares

datum_note: The GeoPDF georeference is on NAD83; NAD83 and WGS 84 differ by about 1 m here and the point is reported as CRS84 without a datum shift.
interpretation: The fence is the applicant's own site definition and follows the KCMO parcel lines of the land it encloses; the centroid is a campus-scale marker for a fenced site of about 426 acres. The positional accuracy of the embedded georeference is not stated.
alternatives_rejected: Platte County parcel layer hosted by the City of Platte City (2022 tax year, no owner fields) does not cover Section 3, T52N, R34W; not used.
Platte County, Platte City and Platte County Assessor web hosts returned HTTP 403 or 522 to robots.txt and were not used.
The union of KCMO parcels inside the fence (505 acres including all of KIVA 171639) over-reaches the fence and the parcel layer dates from December 2023; it is a cross-check, not the locator.
No geocoder, city centre, airport or zone centroid was used.
